import numpy as np
from flash.core.data.utils import download_data

_IMAGENET_URL = "http://data.vision.ee.ethz.ch/krizhevsky/imagenet/full/train.tar"


def get_imagenet_data() -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    # Download the dataset
    dataset = download_data(_IMAGENET_URL)

    # Load it
    import tarfile

    tf = tarfile.open(dataset, mode="r")
    tf.extractall(".")
    tf.close()

    # Get filenames
    from os import listdir

    all_files = listdir("./train")

    # Get labels
    labels = [f[:3] for f in all_files]

    # Convert to arrays
    images = []
    for f in all_files:
        images.append(np.load(f"./train/{f}") / 255.0)

    return np.stack(images), np.array(labels)
